Britain’s troublingly nostalgic new prime minister
In an era of change, Andy Burnham promises to rewind the clock

IT feels AS if the world is accelerating. Remarkable artificial-intelligence models are released by the month. Medicine offers tantalising breakthroughs in everything from cancer to the common cold. And Britain, where self-driving taxis now prowl the streets in one of the first trials in Europe, is poised to reap the fruits of this revolution.
